test_title: PYST 06: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to

that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) URO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0ed3bf50177a9ae3c144a8fc06b0fff8c04a384346a328398e4cdeb16923b11.png] 

Option 2) TQN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/234035c4d3f48dddcd8b94cc5690fc786bc54d79ec137024459eded0d802b580.png] 

Option 3) KIE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bc5cad639ceb8dc0a0f7609d7bf202ac6e1f5d2d7526426c145ec98c0ba2231.png] 

Option 4) WTQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7eec5892727acd036676e2b7fd244bebf3f6ddb0b65ec763ce578c2d69401f67.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'KIE' is the odd one.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
